title: Research: prove a ten-deletion P112 span bound
body:
## Summary

```text
Two P112 six-flats + ten separate line deletions
  -> residual-rank-six directions span at most four
  -> exclude TWOSIDE (5,4) shape 2,4,5,6^6
```

The eight-deletion predecessor leaves three weight shapes in the pinned `(5,4)` boundary. This new finite theorem excludes one, leaving `2,5^3,6^5` and `3,4^2,6^6`. The quotient-basis proof includes an alternative fifty-line support bound using only elementary odd-label capacities and the replayed six-flat cap.

Adds `research/p112-ten-deletion-span/` and its compiler/replay workflow. Direction completeness includes D7 normals, and a signed-Gram check proves the orbit symmetries preserve rational span. The bound holds over characteristic-zero fields. It is sharp for separate deletion sets; sharpness for one common set of ten lines is not claimed.

Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 at `708f0ad8928c383de8294aea3c126e9461d2066d`, Nick Petalas/PR3161 at `a1aba8389b87412e6f72ccf4d11f31e0ea232327`, and the retained E8/P112 decoder lineage. Flat enumeration and the dual-code oracle derive from PR3161. Exact sources, byte-identical excerpts and derivation hashes are retained. Base is canonical main `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`, priority revision 6. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-18998421).

## Evidence

- Before, the `2,4,5,6^6` shape needs ten extra lines, outside the eight-deletion premise. After, its five independent fundamental-circuit directions contradict span at most four.
- Both complete censuses cover all 788,035 annihilators, 776,805 nonempty masks and 123,511,995 representative pairs. The ten-deletion maximum is span four with up to ten directions. All 159 orbit rows, positive witnesses, 45,056 deletion-oracle comparisons, 250 rational-rank controls and the exact weight ledger are committed.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay and all fifteen optimized behavioral tests pass. A full read-only Git-free export generated the same receipt. Strict native diagnostics, Ruff, source/provenance checks and all 22 publication-byte comparisons pass locally at `ebd7fd275288e4a9f658e77fa77a0119a8322e74`.
- Internal read-only reviews checked the Weyl coverage, signed-Gram lifts, quotient argument, native arithmetic and literal witnesses. The full census is not independently reimplemented. Hosted Linux CI and independent human/proof-kernel review are separate.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-ten-deletion-span
```

Requires a C++17 compiler; no third-party Python packages. The direct replay works without Git or network with its two declared inputs. README gives external-work-directory commands and open next questions. A retained five-direction witness rejects an unstructured separate-twelve-deletion span-four extension; it is not a complete twelve-deletion census or a structured common-set counterexample.

No full C5, `C(P112)>=64`, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed. The selected frontier and frozen predecessors are unchanged.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

One opt-in research package and its dedicated workflow. No shared implementation, priority or selected-result changes.
